template.name: Controller
Payload
template.declaration: clock y; int[0,3] pending = NORMAL; // mode captured when the request is decoded

transition.label: pending != BAD_CRC && y >= (pending == DELAYED ? DELAY_MS : 0) + RESP_MIN_MS
resp_ok!

template.name: Host
template.declaration: clock z; // time since fault injection confirmed clock zr; // time since NORMAL restoration confirmed clock zn; // time in nominal

transition.label: zn >= 2 * POLL_MS && link == ONLINE
inject!
mode = FAULT_MODE, z = 0, toutInFault = 0, crcInFault = false, seqInFault = false, offlineInFault = false

template.name: Status
template.declaration: clock w; // time since the previous status report started clock b; // length of the current block

transition.label: w = 0, b = 0, blocked = true, slack = SLIP_MS
w >= STATUS_PERIOD_MS
w = 0, b = 0, blocked = true, slack = SLIP_MS
